title: Are dinosaur fossils hogging top journals? Analysis sparks debate over ‘charismatic’ finds
title_zh: 恐龙化石是否霸占顶级期刊？分析引发关于“吸引人”发现的争论
abstract: Fossils of dinosaurs, mammals and other glamorous species are over-represented in high-profile titles, suggests a study of thousands of palaeontology papers.
abstract_zh: 一项对数千篇古生物学论文的研究表明，恐龙、哺乳动物及其他迷人物种的化石在高知名度期刊中被过度代表。
snippet: Fossils of dinosaurs, mammals and other glamorous species are over-represented in high-profile titles, suggests a study of thousands of palaeontology papers.
